triples.rationale: The Lord sends Jonah to Nineveh because its wickedness has come up before Him. Genesis similarly presents Sodom and Gomorrah's increasing cry and great sins as coming before the Lord ahead of intervention concerning the cities.
triples.source_text: “Rise and go to Nineveh, the great city, and proclaim in it, for the outcry of its wickedness has come up to Me.”

target_units.text: And the Lord said, “The cry of Sodom and Gomorrah has increased, and their sins are exceedingly great.
So I will go down and see whether they are being brought to an end according to their cry which comes to Me; and if not, that I may know.”
